# Hello Blueprint Canary

A minimal test application for blueprint intake validation.

## Goal
Create a simple hello-world project that proves the blueprint intake path works.

## Requirements
- Must produce a README.md file
- Must contain at least one source file
- Must pass a basic validation test

## Acceptance Criteria
- README.md created with project name
- Source file created with hello world
- Test passes
